meta.title: Nil Dental Studio
meta.description: Calm, unhurried dental care. Browse services and book your visit online.

checkup.name: Check-up and consultation
checkup.description: A full examination, a clear explanation of what we see and a plan you can take home.
details: Your first visit, or your regular one. We look at your teeth, gums and bite, take digital X-rays if they are needed, and tell you plainly what we see.
You leave with a written plan in order of priority, with the cost of each step, so you can decide what to do and when.
expect: A short conversation about your health and any concerns
A full examination of teeth, gums and bite
Digital X-rays only where they add something
A written plan with costs, in order of priority

hygiene.name: Hygiene and cleaning
hygiene.description: Scaling, polishing and practical advice to keep your gums healthy between visits.
details: A thorough clean by our hygienist to remove tartar and staining that brushing at home cannot reach.
We take our time, explain what we are doing as we go, and show you simple ways to look after your gums between visits.
expect: A check of your gum health
Scaling to remove tartar above and below the gum line
Polishing to remove surface stains
Practical advice for brushing and cleaning between teeth

fillings.name: Fillings
fillings.description: Tooth-coloured fillings that restore strength and blend with your natural teeth.
details: When decay or a small fracture has damaged a tooth, we remove the damaged part and rebuild it with a tooth-coloured composite.
The tooth is fully numbed first. We keep as much healthy tooth as possible and shape the filling to fit your bite.
expect: Local anaesthetic so you feel no pain
Gentle removal of decay
A tooth-coloured filling matched to your shade
A bite check and polish before you leave

root-canals.name: Root canal treatment
root-canals.description: Infection removed from inside the tooth under full numbing, so you keep your natural tooth.
details: When the nerve inside a tooth is infected or inflamed, root canal treatment removes the infection and saves the tooth.
It is done under full numbing at a calm, steady pace. Some teeth need a second visit; we tell you in advance if yours does.
expect: An X-ray to plan the treatment
Full numbing before we begin
Cleaning and sealing of the root canals
A temporary or permanent filling, and aftercare advice

extractions.name: Extractions
extractions.description: When a tooth cannot be saved, a planned and gentle removal with written aftercare.
details: Sometimes a tooth cannot be saved. When that happens, we plan the removal carefully and make it as gentle as possible.
We talk through the options for replacing the tooth, if you want one, before we begin.
expect: An examination and X-ray beforehand
Full numbing before we begin
A careful, unhurried removal
Written aftercare and a follow-up check

whitening.name: Teeth whitening
whitening.description: Gentle in-clinic whitening, planned around your sensitivity and the result you want.
details: Professional whitening lightens the natural colour of your teeth safely, under supervision.
We check your teeth and gums first, agree a realistic shade with you, and plan around any sensitivity.
expect: A check that whitening is right for you
Your starting shade recorded
Protection for your gums during treatment
Advice on keeping the result

veneers.name: Porcelain veneers
veneers.description: Thin porcelain shells that reshape chipped, worn or uneven front teeth. Price per tooth.
details: Veneers are thin porcelain shells bonded to the front of teeth to change their shape, colour or length.
We plan them with you, show you a preview before anything is made, and remove as little natural tooth as possible.
expect: A consultation about the result you want
A preview of the planned shape and shade
Preparation and impressions or a digital scan
Fitting at a second visit

implants.name: Implant consultation
implants.description: An unhurried assessment of whether implants suit you, with costs and timings in writing.
details: An implant replaces a missing tooth with a titanium post and a crown. This first visit is about whether it is the right choice for you.
We examine the area, take the imaging we need, and give you the treatment plan, costs and timings in writing. There is no obligation to go ahead.
expect: An examination of the gap and the surrounding teeth
Imaging to assess the bone
An honest discussion of the alternatives
A written plan with costs and timings

emergency.name: Urgent appointment
emergency.description: Toothache, a broken tooth or swelling. We keep time free every day for urgent care.
details: Toothache, a broken tooth, a lost filling or swelling: we keep time free every day we are open for urgent problems.
The aim of this visit is to find the cause and get you out of pain. If you need further treatment, we plan it with you.
expect: A focused examination of the problem
An X-ray if it is needed
Treatment to relieve pain where possible
A clear plan for any follow-up

trust.title: Care you can understand and rely on

items.title: Clear, fixed prices
items.body: You see the price before you book, and nothing is added without your agreement.

items.title: Strict hygiene standards
items.body: Instruments are sterilised for every patient, and single-use items are used wherever possible.

items.title: Time to ask questions
items.body: Appointments are planned with room to talk, so nobody feels rushed in the chair.

items.title: Your data stays private
items.body: We collect only what your visit needs and handle it under GDPR.
